name: xbert-bank-statement-upload
description: Turn any bank statement format into the file your accounting system can ingest — PDF, CSV, OFX, QIF, or Excel.

x-xbert.tagline: Turn any bank statement format into the file your accounting system can ingest.
prerequisites: A bank statement file (PDF, CSV, OFX, QIF, or Excel)
Target accounting system identified (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks Online)
x-xbert.longDescription:
New-client onboarding stalls every time a bank statement arrives in the wrong format. The PDF won't import. The CSV has the columns the wrong way around. The OFX file is from a feed the bank turned off six months ago. The bookkeeper ends up retyping rows into a template, account by account, statement by statement — 20 to 40 minutes per account, three to five accounts per onboarding.

XBert Bank Statement Upload takes any statement format the client can send and produces the exact upload file the target accounting system expects. PDFs get text-extracted and line-itemised, CSVs get column-mapped, OFX and QIF files get normalised. Every row is shown back for review before the output drops — high-confidence rows pass through automatically, low-confidence rows get flagged for human eyes. The output is the file Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks Online will accept on the first attempt.

useCases.title: New-client onboarding
useCases.description: Convert a fresh client's last 12 months of PDF statements into the upload format your accounting system needs — without retyping a single row.

useCases.title: Feed gaps and historicals
useCases.description: When a bank feed misses a period or only goes back 90 days, drop the PDFs in and get a clean upload file for the missing history.

useCases.title: Migration between ledgers
useCases.description: Moving a client from MYOB to Xero (or vice versa)? Normalise existing exports into the new target format in one step.

useCases.title: Statements from non-supported banks
useCases.description: When the bank doesn't offer a feed integration, this is the workflow that turns the monthly PDF into a usable import.

benefits.title: 20-40 minutes saved per account
benefits.description: What used to be a tedious retyping job becomes a single upload and a quick review. Multiplied across 3-5 accounts per onboard, that's hours back on day one.

benefits.title: Confirm-before-output safety
benefits.description: Every parsed row is shown for human review before the upload file is generated. High-confidence rows flow through; low-confidence rows are flagged. No blind submissions.

benefits.title: Right format, first time
benefits.description: Output is shaped to the exact specification of your target accounting system — Xero CSV, MYOB import, or QuickBooks Online — so the upload succeeds on the first attempt.

workflow: Identify the target accounting system (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks Online) and provide the source statement file
Plugin extracts and line-itemises the statement via the XBert semantic extraction MCP, flagging low-confidence rows
Review and confirm the extracted rows in chat — accept, edit, or reject before output
Plugin generates the target-formatted upload file and drops it to your file system
